lines.text: An angel with great authority descends from heaven and cries out that Babylon the great has fallen.
A voice from heaven tells God's people to come out of her, because her sins are piled up to heaven.
Her plagues of death, grief and famine will come in one year, and she will be consumed by fire.
The kings of the earth will weep and wail at the smoke, standing at a distance in fear of her torment.
A mighty angel casts a stone like a great millstone into the river, saying Babylon will be cast down.
